test.name: Fact-conflict delegation — hand back to conflict-resolution, write nothing
test.description: The agent's Step 0 scope gate, reached by direct spawn. The delegation asks to weigh two birthplace assertions and decide which is correct — conflict-resolution's work, not a hypothesis. The agent must reply with the one-line hand-back naming conflict-resolution and make no write. Added in issue #2792 when the three description-routing negatives (_014-_016) were deleted: those graded which skill Cowork picked from a description, which never reached this gate; this test reaches the gate itself. A DIRECT negative graded on its invariant (unit-test-spec.md 5.2.1), gated by test_scope_handback_writes_nothing in eval/harness/validators/test_hypothesis_tracking.py.

input.delegation:
Weigh a_002 against a_009 and decide which birthplace is correct for Patrick Flynn.

assertionIds: a_002, a_009
projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: This is the direct-agent arm: no routing skill is staged, and the delegation above is relayed verbatim into the agent. Grade the agent's own behaviour.

Weighing two assertions to decide which fact is correct is conflict-resolution's work. The correct, complete response is the one-line hand-back 'Hand-back: conflict-resolution — <clause>' with no analysis, no file reads and no writes. Do NOT penalize the agent for not weighing the evidence, not creating a hypothesis, or for the reply being one line.
The scope-handback invariant validator decides this test's outcome: no research_append call, research.json unchanged, and a Hand-back line naming conflict-resolution.

negative.explanation: A fact conflict belongs to conflict-resolution. On the direct arm there is no router whose choice could be graded, so the test is graded on the Step 0 invariant: the agent hands back by name and changes nothing.
